content: Jondi meeniŋ mute mede yeniŋila Imeyout tiyemguk

Taibiliya adi Lomahi’walaŋ Mapme Wapum hatilune gulet 15 tubune Jon Imeyout Tububihit adi kwanaiŋiŋ tububihikuk. Nai uŋaniŋ Pontiyas Pailatdi Judiya kwetneŋ kiyap wapum hatiguk, kaŋ Helot adi Galili kwet kadokome hatiluguk, kaŋ kwayaŋ Filip adi Ituliya dut Telekonaitis’walaŋ me wapum hatiguk, eŋ Lisaniya adi Abilinihi’walaŋ me wapum hatiguk,
kaŋ Anas dut Kaifa adi Siloŋyot diniŋ Talitimeŋ Wapum hatigumuk. Kaŋ nai uŋaniŋ Sakaliya mihiŋiŋ Jon adi kwet fiileŋ hatilune Bepaŋ’walaŋ mededi adi’walaŋkade buguk.
Buune Jon adi Jodan Ime fukuniŋ be fukuniŋ yaudapmaaŋ metam indiŋ yenihautaluguk, “Hidi kadakaniŋhik sigilulum tiyemiŋa buune Imeyout tihambe Bepaŋdi kadakaniŋhik tumolokuhambek.”
Polofet Aisaiyadi Youkudip Mede gineŋ indiŋ youkuk wondok tuwot mintaguk,

content.text: “Me niŋ kwet fiileŋ indiŋ kutilak,
‘Wapumdok tiulidoko tineŋ, tiŋa talik didimeŋgoŋ imindok.

Kwet loŋafoŋatnit u tubudidime hinek titiŋdok. Kweboboe wapuhi be kuyahi u fipupuheneune didimeŋgoŋ hinek mintawek. Talik gembugolohi u tubudidime tiŋa iiŋdok, tiŋa kwet tuntunehi hefulaŋa igumuta hinek titiŋdok.
Unduŋ tiŋa metam hogohogok adi Bepaŋdi metamŋiye yehitubu-lodaaŋ kadakaniŋ gineniŋ yanagilaak u kaneeŋ.’”

content: Metam fee adi Jondi Imeyout tiyembek yo bugiŋ kaŋ adi indiŋ yenintoguk, “Hidige! Miŋgembet miknit diniŋ yalakiŋiye hidi! Hidi Bepaŋ’walaŋ kwihita mintaune momonim be yo tiiŋ?

Kadakaniŋhik agaŋ sigilulum tiyemiiŋ habudok wendok kwanai tineŋ. Tiŋa hidegoŋ Abalaham’walaŋ yalakiŋiye mu yoneŋ. Nu biyagoŋ hinek hanilat, Bepaŋ adi kedem yobune kawade yendi Abalaham’walaŋ yalakiŋiye gitipmuŋ mintaneŋ.
Finaŋgon niŋ bem kiliki momooŋgoŋ mu foiŋ u mebi gineŋgoŋ fiyapmaaŋ kudup gineŋ yakutdok woom hatak.”
Unduŋ yeniŋguk kaŋ metamdibo ninadigiŋ, “Unduŋ yolaŋ ale indi dediŋ tinim?”
Unduŋ yobune yeniŋguk, “Nebek niŋ dahidahi lufom nobu moŋgo hatiluwek kaŋ noli me dahidahinit mokitdok mimbek, be nebek niŋ nanaŋenit kaŋ nanaŋe u dane tibek.”
Me takis muneeŋ moŋgomoŋgot tagiŋ me noli Imeyout tine buŋa niŋgiŋ, “Hinale, indi dediŋ tinim?”
Unduŋ niŋgiŋ kaŋ yeniŋguk, “Hidi muneeŋ dediŋ moŋgotdok yoŋit hatak u kalakapme mu tiŋa moŋgokaneeŋ.”

Kaŋ mikme hekidibo buŋa niŋgiŋ, “Kaŋ indiyoŋ, indi dediŋ tinim.” Unduŋ ninadigiŋ kaŋ yeniŋguk, “Metam muneeŋ hamdok yeniŋgigine mu taneeŋ, be metam yalaŋ yeniŋa yanagila yot fafaŋeniŋneŋ mu yapmeyaneeŋ. Kwanaihik diniŋ tuwaŋiŋ dediŋ moŋgokaneeŋ uŋakoŋ nadiune tuwot tiluwaak.”
Jon adi unduŋ yoŋa tubune metam adi kaŋ nadinadihik kaikaune nadibedi tiŋa indiŋ yogiŋ, “Me yadi Kilisto bidak.”

Unduŋ yogiŋ kaŋ Jondibo indiŋ yeniŋguk, “Nu adi imedi hogok Imeyout tihamulat iŋgoŋ me niŋ mindaŋ bulak adi yadi Uŋgoniŋ Munabuli dut kudupdi youhambaak. Adi loloŋnit, nu nalakapmeŋ tilak. Tiŋa nu aindiniŋdi tipilapilaye timindok tuwot moŋ.
Adi yadi yohumuŋnit buŋa nanaŋe yotŋiŋ tutumbawaak. Tiŋa nanaŋe nanaŋdok u daneeŋ yopmaŋ boiwaak eŋ figifigi u yohumuneeŋ wali wooŋ kudup gineŋ heune dawaak.”
Jon adi metam Mede Momooŋ yeniyeniŋ tiŋa metam weleyouyout mede tali fee gineŋ yeniŋguk.
Tiŋa Helot adi dali’walaŋ tam Helodiya lom nagikuk, eŋ nemek kadakaniŋ noli maaŋ tuguk doktiŋa Jondi kamehep mede niŋguk.
Kaŋ Helotdi kudi kadakaniŋ hinek niŋ indiŋ tuguk. Jon nagila yot fafaŋeniŋ gineŋ kameguk.
Jesu Imeyout tulune Uŋgoniŋ Munabuli fotokomiŋguk
Metam hogohogok adi Imeyout tigiŋ kaŋ Jesu maaŋ Imeyout tuguk. Tiŋa ninadi kwanai yatubune kunum dilitombune

Uŋgoniŋ Munabulidi butigili wele tiŋa adi’walaŋ folooŋ foloŋ foguk. Kaŋ kunum gineniŋ mede niŋ indiŋ foguk, “Du adi na’walaŋ mihine hinek, welenedi hinek gabukahilelat. Nu nadigambe utumba hinek tilak.”
Jesu dadaŋiye’walaŋ wohiye hebet
Jesu adi guletŋiŋ 30 tubune kwanaiŋiŋ tububihikuk. Kaŋ metamdi Jesudok nadimimbu Josep’walaŋ mihi tuguk,

content.text: kaŋ Josep adi Heli mihiŋiŋ,
Heli adi Matat mihiŋiŋ, Matat adi Lewi mihiŋiŋ, Lewi adi Meliki mihiŋiŋ, Meliki adi Yanai mihiŋiŋ, Yanai adi Josep mihiŋiŋ,

Nagai adi Maat mihiŋiŋ, Maat adi Matataiyas mihiŋiŋ, Matataiyas adi Semein mihiŋiŋ, Semein adi Yosek mihiŋiŋ, Yosek adi Yoda mihiŋiŋ,
Yoda adi Yoanan mihiŋiŋ, Yoanan adi Lesa mihiŋiŋ, Lesa adi Selababel mihiŋiŋ, Selababel adi Siyatiyel mihiŋiŋ, Siyatiyel adi Neli mihiŋiŋ.
Neli adi Meliki mihiŋiŋ, Meliki adi Edi mihiŋiŋ, Edi adi Kosam mihiŋiŋ, Kosam adi Elimadam mihiŋiŋ, Elimadam adi Eya mihiŋiŋ,

Lewi adi Simion mihiŋiŋ, Simion adi Juda mihiŋiŋ, Juda adi Josep mihiŋiŋ, Josep adi Yonam mihiŋiŋ, Yonam adi Eliyakim mihiŋiŋ,
Eliyakim adi Meliya mihiŋiŋ, Meliya adi Mena mihiŋiŋ, Mena adi Matata mihiŋiŋ, Matata adi Neiten mihiŋiŋ, Neiten adi Dewit mihiŋiŋ,
Dewit adi Jesi mihiŋiŋ, Jesi adi Obet mihiŋiŋ, Obet adi Boas mihiŋiŋ, Boas adi Salmon mihiŋiŋ, Salmon adi Nason mihiŋiŋ,
Nason adi Aminadap mihiŋiŋ, Aminadap adi Atmin mihiŋiŋ, Atmin adi Lam mihiŋiŋ, Lam adi Hesolon mihiŋiŋ, Hesolon adi Peles mihiŋiŋ, Peles adi Juda mihiŋiŋ,
Juda adi Jekop mihiŋiŋ, Jekop adi Aisak mihiŋiŋ, Aisak adi Abalaham mihiŋiŋ, Abalaham adi Tela mihiŋiŋ, Tela adi Neho mihiŋiŋ,
Neho adi Selak mihiŋiŋ, Selak adi Leu mihiŋiŋ, Leu adi Pelek mihiŋiŋ, Pelek adi Iba mihiŋiŋ, Iba adi Sila mihiŋiŋ,
Sila adi Keinan mihiŋiŋ, Keinan adi Afaksat mihiŋiŋ, Afaksat adi Siem mihiŋiŋ, Siem adi Nowa mihiŋiŋ, Nowa adi Lemek mihiŋiŋ,
Lemek adi Metusala mihiŋiŋ, Metusala adi Inok mihiŋiŋ, Inok adi Yelet mihiŋiŋ, Yelet adi Mahalalel mihiŋiŋ, Mahalalel adi Keinan mihiŋiŋ,
Keinan adi Inos mihiŋiŋ, Inos adi Set mihiŋiŋ, Set adi Adam mihiŋiŋ, Adam adi Bepaŋ’walaaniŋ.
